name: ride5-cyclist-strachan
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; let X = -2532, Z = -290;  app.cameraSystem.cinema = null; app.selectMode('cyclist'); app.teleportTo(X, Z, 0); const e = app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(); const t0 = performance.now(); let last = -1, maxDy = 0, py = null; const id = setInterval(() => { const t = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000; if (py !== null) maxDy = Math.max(maxDy, Math.abs(e.position.y - py)); py = e.position.y; if (Math.floor(t * 2) !== last) { last = Math.floor(t * 2); console.log('[ride] ride5-cyclist-strachan t ' + t.toFixed(1) + ' x ' + e.position.x.toFixed(1) + ' z ' + e.position.z.toFixed(1) + ' y ' + e.position.y.toFixed(2) + ' cut ' + C.cutAt(e.position.x, e.position.z).toFixed(2) + ' v ' + (e.speed || 0).toFixed(1) + ' maxStep ' + maxDy.toFixed(3) + ' near ' + [...app.trafficSystem.cars, ...app.trafficSystem.buses].filter((v) => v.active !== false && Math.hypot(v.x - e.position.x, v.z - e.position.z) < 12).map((v) => (v.z - e.position.z).toFixed(0) + '/' + (v.speed || 0).toFixed(1) + '/y' + (v.y || 0).toFixed(1)).join(',')); } if (t > 39.5) clearInterval(id); }, 50); })()
